title: The Row
summary: Some of the Slagborn went over to the Forgehall when Oruth woke, and fight for whoever lit it. Their leaders keep the rest there. Gunnar wants the rest home.

steps.journal: The Forgehall, the Cinderworks' first floor: the renegades' leaders come with every fifth lot. Put down three.

ready: Three of the renegades' leaders are down. Tell Gunnar Slagg.
done: The Slagborn are walking home in ones and twos. Gunnar is drinking where the row can see him.
